title: MELTS: Datasource Coverage KPI
description: Single KPI showing how many Logan log sources contributed evidence to the active MELTS attack window. Use it to detect missing ingestion coverage before starting the hunt.
query: ('Trace ID' = 'trace_clickfix_2026_001' or 'Trace ID' = 'trace_toolshell_sp_001' or 'Trace ID' = 'trace_rmm_2025_001' or 'Trace ID' = 'trace_aitm_token_2026_001' or 'Threat Name' = 'ClickFix Clipboard Execution' or 'Threat Name' = 'CrashFix Python RAT' or 'Threat Name' = 'RMM Tool Abuse' or 'Threat Name' = 'AiTM Token Replay' or 'Request URL' like '*spinstall0.aspx*' or 'Command Line' like '*ClickFix*' or 'Command Line' like '*CrashFix*' or 'Process Name' like '*ScreenConnect*' or 'Process Name' like '*AnyDesk*' or 'Process Name' like '*AteraAgent*' or 'User Name' = 'codeofconduct-reader@corp.example.com') | stats distinctcount('Log Source') as DataSources

ask_ai_prompts: Identify any expected MELTS datasource that is missing from the last-week hunt.

falsepositives: A lab run that intentionally generates only a subset of sources
